name: Linkly
description:
Linkly is a link-management and analytics platform. Connect it to Claude to create branded short links, look up and search your links, read click analytics (time-series, broken down by country, device and referrer, plus raw exports), manage custom domains, and configure click webhooks — all within your authenticated Linkly workspace.

Sign in with Linkly via OAuth; there are no API keys to copy or paste.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Linkly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Linkly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.linklyhq.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Linkly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Linkly lists 25 MCP tools, including batchDeleteLinks, create_domain, create_link, delete_domain, delete_link, export_clicks, get_analytics, get_analytics_by, get_clicks, get_link, list_domains, and list_link_webhooks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Linkly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Linkly in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Linkly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Linkly is developed by Linkly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
